title: Fecal microbiome transplant in food allergy in humans and mice identifies a role for bile acid metabolites in oral tolerance.
abstract: The gut microbiome has been implicated in the pathogenesis of food allergy (FA), prompting microbiome-focused interventions. We evaluated, in a phase 1 open-label trial (NCT02960074), the safety and efficacy of oral encapsulated fecal microbiome transplantation (FMT) in 15 adults with peanut allergies. An increase in the peanut reactivity threshold was noted in 3 of 10 participants not pretreated with antibiotics and 3 of 5 participants pretreated with antibiotics, without safety issues. In responders, FMT increased tolerogenic RORγt + regulatory T cells (T reg cells) and decreased T helper 2 cells (T H 2 cells). Mice transplanted with the microbiomes of post-FMT responders were protected from FA in association with increased RORγt + T reg cell percentages and increased colonization with members of the gut Bacteroides . In both humans and mice, protection by FMT was associated with increased bile acid metabolites. Deletion of a bile salt hydrolase in a candidate protective Bacteroides abrogated FA suppression in mice. These results suggest that FMT is a safe and potentially promising therapeutic modality for treating FA.
authors: Rachid R, Martinez-Blanco M, Kuziel GA, Stephen-Victor E, Groussin M, Orakov A, Russell G, Nguyen LTT, Poyet M, Mukhatayev Z, Yee CSK, Albuhairi S, Kteish R, Rahman EA, Farraj FA, Wang Z, Dahlberg S, Ryan M, Fitzgerald M, Elverson W, Lee JJ, Schneider L, MacGinnitie A, Crestani E, Queheillalt D, Burke-Roberts E, Watson J, Elliott RJ, Wong WF, Osman M, Voyksner R, Hohmann E, Huttenhower C, Alm E, Rakoff-Nahoum S, Chatila TA.
screening_reason: Directly evaluates fecal microbiome transplantation, gut Bacteroides colonization, and microbial bile acid metabolites in driving immune tolerance.
summary_ja: ピーナッツアレルギー成人患者15名を対象に経口経腸経菌叢移植（FMT）の安全性および有効性を評価する第1相非盲検試験が実施された。FMT投与後に一部の参加者でピーナッツ反応閾値の上昇が観察され、応答者ではRORγt+制御性T細胞の増加とTh2細胞の減少が認められた。さらに応答者の腸内細菌叢を移植されたマウスにおいても食品アレルギーからの保護効果とBacteroides属の生着が観察された。ヒトおよびマウスの双方で保護効果は胆汁酸代謝物の増加と関連しており、候補細菌における胆汁酸水解酵素の欠損によってアレルギー抑制効果が消失した。
summary_en: A phase 1 open-label trial evaluated oral encapsulated fecal microbiome transplantation in adults with peanut allergies. FMT was safe and increased the peanut reactivity threshold in a subset of participants, accompanied by an increase in RORgt+ regulatory T cells. In mouse models, protection conferred by FMT was linked to Bacteroides colonization and elevated bile acid metabolites, which required bacterial bile salt hydrolase activity.
key_finding_ja: ピーナッツアレルギー患者へのFMTは安全に実施可能であり、Bacteroides属や胆汁酸代謝物を介して経口免疫寛容を誘導する可能性が示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 腸内細菌叢およびその代謝物を標的としたアプローチが、食品アレルギーの新たな治療戦略となる可能性が期待される。

title: Targeting peripheral 5-HT 2A R enhances antitumor immunity in colorectal cancer.
abstract: Cancer remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide. While classical psychedelics have been used clinically to treat cancer-associated psychiatric disorders, their impact on tumor progression is unclear. Here, we show that by targeting the serotonin receptor 5-HT2AR, lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD) enhances CD8+ T cell-mediated antitumor immunity and suppresses colorectal cancer (CRC) growth. To harness this activity while avoiding psychedelic effects, we developed IHCH-8110, a non-brain-penetrant 5-HT2AR agonist that selectively targets peripheral 5-HT2AR. We show that IHCH-8110 inhibits CRC progression by activating 5-HT2AR on enteric glial cells, thereby inducing CXCL10 and interleukin (IL)-18 expression to promote CD8+ T cell recruitment and effector polarization within the tumor microenvironment. By converting immune-cold CRC into a more immunologically responsive state, IHCH-8110 enhances the efficacy of PD-1 blockade. Together, our findings identify enteric 5-HT2AR signaling as a regulator of antitumor immunity and support peripheral 5-HT2AR agonists as a therapeutic strategy for CRC immunotherapy.
authors: Wen Y, Tang L, Duan W, Ren Q, Ni Y, Chen S, Chen J, Yang L, Wang H, Chen Y, Zheng Y, Pan X, Du H, Huang M, Zeng A, Zhou Z, Zhang Z, Ji H, Ge G, Zeng YA, Zhang W, Wang S, Cheng J, Wang S, Chen J.
screening_reason: Directly links enteric glial cell 5-HT2AR activation to immune cell recruitment and antitumor neuroimmune interactions in colorectal cancer.
summary_ja: 大腸がんにおける抗腫瘍免疫を増強するため、末梢のセロトニン受容体5-HT2ARを標的とする新規な非脳移行性アゴニストIHCH-8110が開発された。IHCH-8110は腸管グリア細胞上の5-HT2ARを刺激することでCXCL10およびIL-18の発現を誘導し、腫瘍微小環境へのCD8+ T細胞の浸潤と活性化を促進した。これにより冷たい腫瘍（immune-cold CRC）の免疫応答性が高まり、抗PD-1抗体治療の抗腫瘍効果が補強された。本研究は腸管神経系と腫瘍免疫の関連性を解明し、末梢5-HT2ARを標的としたがん免疫療法の有効性を示している。
summary_en: Researchers developed IHCH-8110, a non-brain-penetrant 5-HT2AR agonist that targets peripheral 5-HT2AR on enteric glial cells to enhance antitumor immunity in colorectal cancer. Activation of 5-HT2AR induced CXCL10 and IL-18 expression, recruiting CD8+ T cells to the tumor microenvironment and suppressing tumor growth. This strategy converted immune-cold colorectal cancer into a responsive state, thereby increasing the therapeutic efficacy of PD-1 blockade.
key_finding_ja: 腸管グリア細胞の5-HT2AR刺激がCXCL10やIL-18を介してCD8+ T細胞を腫瘍に誘導し、大腸がんに対する抗腫瘍免疫を増強することが見出された。
why_it_matters_ja: 末梢の腸管神経-免疫シグナルを制御する選択的アゴニストが大腸がん免疫療法の新たな併用治療薬となる可能性がある。

title: Faecal proteases and immune signatures drive subtype-specific enteric neuronal activation in IBS.
abstract: Luminal proteases have been implicated in epithelial barrier dysfunction and visceral hypersensitivity in irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), yet their impact on the enteric nervous system (ENS), the principal regulator of gastrointestinal function, remains unknown. To investigate whether faecal mediators differentially activate enteric neurons across IBS subtypes and whether proteolytic and proteomic profiles explain neuronal phenotypes. The effects of faecal supernatants (FSN) from 21 IBS-D (diarrhoea-predominant), 9 IBS-C (constipation-predominant) and 18 healthy control (HC) patients recruited across centres in three countries on guinea pig distal colon submucous plexus neurons were assessed using a neuroimaging technique. Faecal proteolytic activities and proteomic profiles were analysed. IBS-D and IBS-C supernatants evoked significantly stronger neuronal activation than HC, demonstrating that FSN directly modulate ENS. In IBS-D, but not IBS-C, effects were mediated by serine and cysteine proteases and PAR-1. Proteome analysis revealed a significant difference in 47 proteins between IBS-D and HC, including several immunoglobulin components, underlying the role of microinflammation in IBS-D. A combination of amylases, trypsin-2 and an immunoglobulin protein demonstrated high diagnostic performance to distinguish IBS-D from HC. These findings uncover a previously unrecognised luminal-ENS axis in IBS and reveal fundamentally different pathological mechanisms between IBS-D and IBS-C. IBS-D is characterised by proteases and PAR-1-dependent neuronal activation and a distinct immune-enriched faecal proteome, whereas mediators in IBS-C act independently of these factors. These findings establish a functional link between faecal protease activity, ENS signalling and molecular biomarkers, highlighting new therapeutic and diagnostic avenues for subtype-specific management of IBS.
authors: Ridžal L, Frieling T, Róka R, Inczefi O, Bacsur P, Bajcsi D, Neunlist MM, Cardaillac C, Theodorou V, Yoon H, Wang J, Ludwig C, Wudy SI, Pankotai T, Páhi ZG, Mansouri N, Luksch H, Michel K, Schemann M, Annaházi A.
screening_reason: Directly examines the activation of enteric nervous system neurons by luminal proteases and immune mediators in irritable bowel syndrome.
summary_ja: 過敏性腸症候群（IBS）患者の糞便上清が腸管神経系に与える影響を評価するため、IBS-D、IBS-C、健常対照群のサンプルを用いてモルモット粘膜下神経叢の神経応答を解析した。その結果、IBS-DおよびIBS-Cの糞便上清は健常群と比較して有意に強い神経活性化を引き起こすことが示された。IBS-Dにおける神経活性化はセリン・システインプロテアーゼおよびPAR-1を介していたのに対し、IBS-Cではこれらに依存しない異なる機序が示唆された。さらにプロテオーム解析により、IBS-D群と健常群の間で免疫関連のタンパク質を含む複数の変動が同定された。
summary_en: This study investigated the impact of faecal supernatants from patients with IBS-D, IBS-C, and healthy controls on submucous plexus neurons. Faecal supernatants from both IBS subtypes evoked stronger neuronal activation than those from healthy controls, revealing direct modulation of the enteric nervous system. In IBS-D, this activation was mediated by serine and cysteine proteases and PAR-1, alongside a distinct immune-enriched faecal proteome, whereas IBS-C acted independently of these factors.
key_finding_ja: IBS-DとIBS-Cの糞便上清はともに腸管神経を直接活性化させるが、IBS-DではプロテアーゼおよびPAR-1を介した異なる病態メカニズムが関与していることが明らかになった。
why_it_matters_ja: IBSのサブタイプに応じた病態生化学的メカニズムの違いが示されたことで、サブタイプ特異的な診断や治療法の開発につながる可能性がある。

title: PALM-Scan enables single-molecule site-specific detection of protein S-palmitoylation with a nanopore.
abstract: Protein S-palmitoylation is a dynamic and reversible post-translational modification (PTM) that governs diverse cellular processes, yet its study remains constrained by the indirect and ensemble-averaging nature of classical biochemical assays. Here, we report a nanopore-based platform, PALM-Scan (palmitoylation analysis via label-free monitoring and signature capture on nanopore) that directly transduces physicochemical signatures of S-palmitoylated peptides into digital electrical signals. Using an engineered Mycobacterium smegmatis porin A (M2-MspA) nanopore, PALM-Scan enables sequence-independent identification of S-palmitoylation and simultaneously differentiates S-palmitoylation from other cysteine-directed PTMs, including S-nitrosylation and S-glutathionylation, without probes or enrichment. We further demonstrate its translational potential by successfully detecting and distinguishing S-palmitoylated subpopulations of disease-relevant biomarkers, including mouse beclin-1 (BECN1)- and glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP)-derived peptides, in complex mixtures with minimal sample input. In summary, by integrating label-free operation, single-molecule resolution, and multiplex discrimination, PALM-Scan provides a transformative tool for interrogating S-palmitoylation dynamics in both basic research and biomedical applications.
authors: Zhang Z, Yang X, Sun Y, Hao Y, Li Y, Wang Y, Xie C, Peng P, Liu S, Jiang X, Zhang Z, Kong E, Wang L, Yang A.
screening_reason: Develops a single-molecule nanopore platform directly measuring site-specific protein S-palmitoylation, a key post-translational modification.
summary_ja: タンパク質のS-パルミトイル化を直接かつ単一分子レベルで検出するナノポア技術「PALM-Scan」が開発された。改変型MspAナノポアを用いることで、標識や濃縮工程を必要とせずにS-パルミトイル化ペプチドの物理化学的特徴を電気信号へと変換することに成功した。また、S-ニトロシル化やS-グルタチオン化など他のシステイン修飾との識別や配列に依存しない同定が可能であった。BECN1やGFAP由来ペプチドを用いた実証実験により、複雑な混合物中での病的バイオマーカーのサブグループ検出における有用性が示された。
summary_en: The authors developed PALM-Scan, a nanopore-based platform for direct, label-free, single-molecule detection of protein S-palmitoylation. Utilizing an engineered MspA nanopore, the technique discriminates S-palmitoylation from other cysteine PTMs without probes or enrichment steps. Its translational capacity was demonstrated by distinguishing S-palmitoylated subpopulations of disease-relevant peptides, including BECN1 and GFAP.
key_finding_ja: ナノポア技術を用いたPALM-Scanにより、ラベルフリーかつ単一分子解像度でタンパク質のS-パルミトイル化を他のシステイン修飾と区別して検出することに成功した。
why_it_matters_ja: 様々な疾患に関連するタンパク質修飾の動態を簡便かつ高精度に解析する新たな計測基盤となることが期待される。

title: Interleukin-25: orchestrating resistance to intestinal helminth infections.
abstract: Interleukin-25 (IL-25) has emerged as a central regulator of type 2 immunity at mucosal surfaces. Beyond its classical role as an epithelial alarmin, IL-25 acts as a multifunctional coordinator of epithelial sensing, immune activation, and tissue adaptation during helminth infection. In the intestine, tuft cells detect helminth- and microbiota-derived metabolites and activate a feed-forward circuit with type 2 innate lymphoid cells (ILC2s), promoting antiparasitic immunity and barrier protection. Emerging evidence further links IL-25 to neuroimmune communication, epithelial remodeling, tissue resilience, and disease tolerance. Here, we summarize recent advances in IL-25 biology, including ILC2 specialization and the distinct roles of IL-25 in nematode and trematode infections, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic target to enhance mucosal protection while limiting immunopathology.
authors: Cociancic P, Fiallos E, Esteban JG, Muñoz-Antoli C, Toledo R.
screening_reason: Focuses on IL-25 driven intestinal mucosal immunity, epithelial metabolite sensing, and neuroimmune communication.
summary_ja: インターロイキン-25（IL-25）は粘膜表面における2型免疫の主要な調節因子として機能している。腸管においてはタフト細胞が寄生虫や腸内細菌由来の代謝物を感知し、2型自然リンパ球（ILC2）とのフィードフォワード回路を活性化して駆虫免疫やバリア保護を推進する。近年の研究により、IL-25は神経免疫連関や上皮のリモデリング、組織のレジリエンス維持にも関与することが明らかになりつつある。本総説では、線虫や吸虫感染におけるIL-25の役割やILC2の専門化に関する最新の知見をまとめている。
summary_en: This review highlights the central role of interleukin-25 in orchestrating type 2 immunity and tissue adaptation during intestinal helminth infections. In the intestine, tuft cells detect microbial and helminth metabolites to activate ILC2-mediated antiparasitic responses and barrier protection. Recent findings also connect IL-25 to neuroimmune communication and epithelial remodeling, positioning it as a potential therapeutic target.
key_finding_ja: IL-25はタフト細胞とILC2の相互作用や神経免疫連関を通じて、腸管寄生虫感染に対する生体防御と組織適応を統合的に制御している。
why_it_matters_ja: IL-25を介した粘膜保護機構の解明は、免疫病理を抑えつつ寄生虫感染症や粘膜疾患を制御する新たな治療標的の同定につながる可能性がある。

title: Gastrointestinal In Situ Self-Assembled Gastrodia Elata Polysaccharide Hydrogel Enables Parkinson's Disease Therapy via Gut-Brain Axis Modulation.
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is closely associated with abnormal α-synuclein propagation along the gut-brain axis and progressive dopaminergic neuronal loss. Traditional oral preparations suffer from weak gastrointestinal resistance, rapid degradation and poor gut-brain axis regulation. Here, we constructed a gastrodia elata polysaccharide-functionalized dual-network GEPH hydrogel via thiol-maleimide click crosslinking. GEPH possesses favorable biocompatibility, regular porous microstructure and tailored rheological properties suitable for gastrointestinal delivery, showing outstanding erosion resistance and structural stability in simulated intestinal fluid. It achieves in situ gelation in the gastrointestinal tract and maintains 24 h long-term retention after oral administration. GEPH modulates gut microbiota composition and metabolite profiles, repairs intestinal barrier and neuronal injury in PD mice such as Corynebacterium, CAG_95, and Akkermansia, while regulated metabolite abundance such as 3-methyl-4-cis-hydroxy-2-butenal, Nicotinic acid, Linolenate. By regulating the TLR4/NF-κB pathway and gut-brain axis, it inhibits abnormal aggregation and spread of intestinal and cerebral α-synuclein, alleviates neuroinflammation and neuronal apoptosis, protects dopaminergic neurons and ameliorates motor dysfunction. This study proposes GEPH as a new type of oral functionalized dual-network hydrogel formulation that regulates the gut-brain axis, promoting the clinical application of a new strategy for oral drug administration for gastrointestinal prevention and treatment of PD.
authors: Lei T, Yang X, Fu G, Li G, Wu Y, Xue X, Zhao Y, Zhang S, Li T, Yang H.
screening_reason: Studies oral hydrogel modulation of gut microbiota composition, the gut-brain axis, and neuroinflammation in a Parkinson's disease model.
summary_ja: 本研究では、経口投与後に消化管内で自己組織化する天麻多糖機能化ハイドロゲル（GEPH）を開発し、パーキンソン病に対する治療効果を評価した。GEPHは消化管内で24時間保持され、腸内細菌叢の構成や代謝物プロファイルを調節するとともに腸管バリア機能を修復した。さらに、TLR4/NF-κB経路および腸脳相関の調節を介してαシヌクレインの異常集積や伝播を抑制した。その結果、神経炎症やドパミン作動性神経の脱落が軽減され、運動機能障害が改善した。
summary_en: Researchers developed a Gastrodia elata polysaccharide-functionalized hydrogel (GEPH) that self-assembles in the gastrointestinal tract and is retained for 24 hours after oral administration. In a Parkinson's disease mouse model, GEPH modulated gut microbiota composition and metabolite profiles, repaired the intestinal barrier, and inhibited alpha-synuclein aggregation. Through TLR4/NF-kB and gut-brain axis regulation, GEPH reduced neuroinflammation and attenuated motor dysfunction.
key_finding_ja: 消化管内で自己組織化する天麻多糖ハイドロゲルは、腸内細菌叢および腸脳相関の調節を介してαシヌクレインの蓄積と神経炎症を抑え、パーキンソン病モデルマウスの運動機能を改善した。
why_it_matters_ja: 腸脳相関に着目したハイドロゲル製剤は、パーキンソン病に対する経口ドラッグデリバリーの新たな治療戦略となる可能性がある。

title: Esketamine alleviates neuroinflammation and cognitive impairment in male 3xTg-AD mice by regulating the TAOK1/IL-17 axis.
abstract: Beyond its antidepressant effects, esketamine (ESK) has the potential to enhance neuroplasticity, facilitating the reconnection with emotional and cognitive processes, improving social cognition, and promoting resilience. However, not much is known about its role in Alzheimer's disease (AD). This study aims to explore the potential mechanism of ESK in AD treatment. The potential targets of ESK were predicted by bioinformatics analysis, and 3xTg-AD male mice were subjected to adeno-associated virus and ESK treatment. Cognitive ability, neuronal damage, and proinflammatory factors in 3xTg-AD mice were evaluated. An inflammatory model was established by inducing mouse cortical neurons with mouse IL-17A protein. Neuronal viability was assessed after treatment with different concentrations of ESK. TAOK1 knockdown or IL-17RA knockdown was performed on 3xTg-AD mice and neurons. TAOK1 was highly expressed in the cerebral cortex of ESK-treated 3xTg-AD mice. ESK improved IL-17-induced neuronal inflammation and DNA damage in a TAOK1-dependent manner. TAOK1 interacted with IL-17RA. IL-17RA knockdown improved DNA damage and inflammatory responses in cells and alleviated cognitive impairment and neuroinflammation in AD mice. Overall, ESK protects against DNA damage-mediated neuroinflammation by promoting TAOK1 and inhibiting IL-17 signaling, thereby improving cognitive dysfunction in 3xTg-AD mice.
authors: Xu T, Zhang C, Yang Y, Shen Z, Zhong Z.
journal: Canadian journal of physiology and pharmacology
screening_reason: Investigates how esketamine regulates the TAOK1/IL-17 axis to mitigate neuroinflammation and cognitive impairment in an Alzheimer's mouse model.
summary_ja: 本研究は、アルツハイマー病モデルの雄性3xTg-ADマウスを用いて、エスケタミンの神経炎症改善効果およびその作用機序を検証した。エスケタミン投与により大脳皮質でTAOK1の発現が上昇し、TAOK1とIL-17RAの相互作用を介してIL-17誘導性の神経炎症とDNA損傷が抑制された。さらに、IL-17RAのノックダウンはマウスの認知機能障害および神経炎症を軽減した。以上より、エスケタミンはTAOK1の促進とIL-17シグナル阻害を通じて認知機能を改善することが示された。
summary_en: This study investigated the neuroprotective mechanisms of esketamine in a male mouse model of Alzheimer's disease. Esketamine reduced IL-17-induced neuronal inflammation and DNA damage through a mechanism involving high expression of TAOK1 and interaction with IL-17RA. Consequently, esketamine administration or IL-17RA knockdown mitigated cognitive impairment and neuroinflammation in 3xTg-AD mice.
key_finding_ja: エスケタミンはTAOK1の発現促進とIL-17シグナル阻害を介して、アルツハイマー病モデルマウスの神経炎症と認知機能障害を改善した。
why_it_matters_ja: アルツハイマー病に伴う神経炎症を標的とした新たな薬物療法の機序解明に寄与する可能性がある。

title: A Vagal-Renal-Splenic Reflex Suppresses Renal Sympathetic Nerve Activity and Preserves Kidney Function After Ischemic Injury.
abstract: Background Acute kidney injury (AKI) is associated with maladaptive increases in renal sympathetic nerve activity (RSNA) and frequently progresses to chronic kidney disease. Neuromodulatory strategies that suppress sympathetic outflow may provide therapeutic benefit. We tested whether afferent vagus nerve stimulation mitigates ischemic AKI by modulating renal sympathetic nerve activity through central autonomic circuits and splenic neuroimmune signaling. Methods Retrograde transsynaptic pseudorabies virus tracing was used to identify neural pathways linking the kidney to vagal sensory circuits in C57BL/6J mice. RSNA, arterial pressure, and heart rate were recorded during intermittent afferent vagus nerve stimulation. Bilateral renal ischemia-reperfusion injury (IRI) was used to assess therapeutic efficacy. Mechanistic studies included subdiaphragmatic vagotomy, renal denervation controls, splenectomy, ganglionic blockade and c-Fos mapping. Results Pseudorabies virus tracing identified polysynaptic pathways linking the kidney to nodose ganglia, dorsal root ganglia, and central autonomic nuclei, with controls supporting tracer specificity. Afferent vagus nerve stimulation (aVNS) produced frequency-dependent and sustained suppression of RSNA. In IRI, aVNS attenuated RSNA surges, preserved GFR, reduced tubular injury markers including NGAL and KIM-1, and limited fibrosis. Protection was observed with both preconditioning and delayed treatment, including stimulation initiated up to 72 hours after injury. Ganglionic blockade abolished acute aVNS responses. Splenectomy eliminated the full RSNA-lowering and renoprotective effects of aVNS, while aVNS reduced systemic norepinephrine and altered splenic signaling. Conclusions Afferent vagus nerve stimulation engages kidney-associated vagal-autonomic pathways that suppress renal sympathetic nerve activity and require splenic signaling for full renoprotection after ischemic AKI.
authors: Mohammed M, Ekperikpe U, Nair SS, Lazartigues E, Tewari AK, Padanilam BJ.
journal: Journal of the American Society of Nephrology : JASN
screening_reason: Identifies a vagal-autonomic-splenic neuroimmune reflex circuit that modulates sympathetic outflow and tissue injury.
summary_ja: 急性腎障害は腎交感神経活動の過剰な上昇を伴い、慢性腎臓病へと進行しやすいことが知られています。本研究ではマウスモデルを用い、求心性迷走神経刺激が腎交感神経活動および虚血再灌流障害に与える影響を検証しました。その結果、求心性迷走神経刺激は腎交感神経活動を持続的に抑制し、虚血後の腎機能低下や組織の線維化を軽減することが明らかになりました。さらに脾臓摘出によってこの保護効果および神経抑制効果が消失したことから、脾臓を介した神経免疫シグナル伝達の重要性が示されました。
summary_en: This study investigated whether afferent vagus nerve stimulation mitigates ischemic acute kidney injury by modulating renal sympathetic nerve activity through central autonomic circuits. In mice, stimulation suppressed renal sympathetic nerve activity, preserved kidney function, and reduced tubular injury and fibrosis after ischemia-reperfusion. These protective effects required splenic signaling, highlighting a kidney-associated vagal-splenic neuroimmune pathway.
key_finding_ja: 求心性迷走神経刺激は腎交感神経活動を抑制し、脾臓を介した神経免疫経路を通じて虚血性腎障害を軽減する。
why_it_matters_ja: 迷走神経と脾臓を結ぶ自律神経・免疫非侵襲的アプローチの理解は、急性腎障害の進行を防ぐ新たな神経調節療法の開発に貢献する可能性があります。

title: Gut microbiome and avascular necrosis: A scoping review of current evidence and knowledge gaps.
abstract: Avascular necrosis (AVN) is a progressive bone disorder characterized by impaired blood supply, osteocyte death, and structural collapse, most commonly affecting the femoral head. In recent years, growing evidence has suggested that gut microbiota may influence skeletal health through immune, metabolic, and vascular pathways. This scoping review aimed to systematically map current evidence on the relationship between gut microbiota and AVN and to identify key knowledge gaps. Following Joanna Briggs Institute methodology and PRISMA-ScR guidelines, a comprehensive search of PubMed, EMBASE, ScienceDirect, Web of Science Core Collection, ClinicalTrials.gov, and Cochrane CENTRAL was conducted. Thirteen eligible studies, including experimental, clinical, multi-omics, and Mendelian randomization analyses, were included. The available evidence indicates that AVN, particularly glucocorticoid- and alcohol-associated forms, is consistently associated with intestinal dysbiosis, reduced production of short-chain fatty acids, immune activation, vascular impairment, and altered bone remodeling. Animal and translational studies demonstrate partial reversal of pathological changes through microbiota-targeted interventions, while human studies reveal etiology-specific microbiota-metabolome signatures. Genetic analyses further support a potential causal contribution of selected microbial taxa and pathways. Overall, current data support the existence of a multidimensional gut-bone axis in AVN. However, most evidence remains indirect - derived from animal models, cross-sectional human studies, and genetic inference rather than from direct interventional testing in patients. Well-designed longitudinal and interventional investigations are needed to clarify causality and therapeutic potential.
authors: Poboży T, Poboży K, Domańska-Poboża J, Kotela A, Konarski W.
screening_reason: Scoping review focusing directly on the relationship between gut microbiome dysbiosis, microbial short-chain fatty acids, and avascular necrosis.
summary_ja: 本スコーピングレビューは、特発性大腿骨頭壊死症などの骨頭壊死（AVN）と腸内細菌叢との関連に関する13件の研究を統合・分析した。AVNは腸内細菌のディスバイオーシス、短鎖脂肪酸の減少、免疫活性化、血管障害などと一貫して関連していることが確認された。動物モデルや遺伝学的解析からは腸内細菌を標的とした介入の有効性が示唆されているが、ヒト患者における直接的な介入検証データは限られている。著者らは、因果関係と治療効果を明らかにするための縦断的・介入的研究の必要性を強調している。
summary_en: This scoping review analyzed 13 studies to map current evidence on the relationship between the gut microbiota and avascular necrosis (AVN). The findings indicate that AVN is consistently associated with intestinal dysbiosis, reduced short-chain fatty acids, immune activation, and vascular impairment. While translational and genetic studies support a gut-bone axis in AVN, direct clinical interventional evidence in human patients remains limited.
key_finding_ja: 骨頭壊死と腸内細菌叢の異常および短鎖脂肪酸の減少との間に関連性が認められたが、ヒトでの直接的な介入研究は不足している。
why_it_matters_ja: 腸-骨軸の解明が進めば、骨頭壊死に対する腸内細菌叢を標的とした新たな予防法や治療法の開発につながる可能性がある。

title: Cytokine-mediated immune-to-brain signaling in neural circuit disorders.
abstract: Neuroinflammation has emerged as a fundamental driver of neural circuit dysfunctions across a spectrum of neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders. Beyond classical neuroimmune pathologies, accumulating evidence indicates that systemic inflammatory states - including those elicited by infection, metabolic dysfunction, stress, or peripheral immune activation - induce profound and long-lasting alterations in brain development and function. Cytokines act as critical molecular mediators of this peripheral-to-central immune communication, precisely orchestrating microglial activation in a spatiotemporally restricted manner. Inflammasome-dependent signaling, particularly NLRP3 activation and subsequent cytokine release, has a central role in shaping microglial states during neuroinflammation. Here, we integrate current evidence linking systemic inflammation to microglial cytokine signaling programs and discuss how these cascades shape synaptic development, refinement, and circuit function. Although synapse pruning and cytokine-mediated microglial signaling jointly contribute to circuit remodeling, we highlight cytokine-driven microglial state amplification as a central mechanism linking systemic inflammation to neural circuit instability. We also highlight that specific cytokines can exert direct effects on neuronal populations - independent of microglial intermediates - to context-dependently modulate synaptic efficacy and circuit excitability. Finally, we evaluate the mechanisms linking systemic inflammation to brain dysfunction and highlight emerging translational opportunities, including the therapeutic repurposing of cytokine-targeting and immunomodulatory agents for neuropsychiatric interventions.
authors: Lee Y, Ko J, Um JW.
screening_reason: Focuses directly on cytokine-mediated neuroimmune signaling, microglial activation, and neuroinflammation in neural circuit function.
summary_ja: 本レビューは、全身性炎症やサイトカインを介した免疫-脳シグナル伝達が神経回路障害に与える影響について整理している。サイトカインはミクログリアの状態を空間的・時間的に制御するだけでなく、ニューロンに直接作用してシナプス効力や回路の興奮性を変化させる。炎症性シグナルカスケードとシナプス再編が回路の不安定化につながるメカニズムを概説している。サイトカイン標的治療など、神経精神疾患に対する免疫調節薬の臨床応用の可能性を評価している。
summary_en: This review summarizes how systemic inflammation and cytokine-mediated signaling disrupt neural circuit function in neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders. Cytokines orchestrate microglial states and can also act directly on neuronal populations to modulate synaptic efficacy and circuit excitability. The authors evaluate prospective translational opportunities, including immunomodulatory and cytokine-targeting agents for neuropsychiatric conditions.
key_finding_ja: 全身性炎症はサイトカインを介してミクログリアの活性化や神経細胞への直接作用を引き起こし、神経回路の不安定化をもたらす。
why_it_matters_ja: 免疫系と脳神経回路の相互作用の解明は、神経精神疾患に対するサイトカイン標的療法の開発につながる可能性がある。

title: A reproducible three-dimensional model of human brain tissue to investigate physiological and disease-associated microglia phenotypes.
abstract: Stem-cell-based in vitro models offer promising potential to elucidate human brain cell functions and interactions, but limitations in reproducibility, maturation and cell-type diversity persist. Especially, prolonged incorporation of mature microglia and studies of neuroinflammation have proven challenging. Here, we developed a human induced pluripotent stem cell-based three-dimensional cortical brain tissue model (3BTM) containing neurons, astrocytes and microglia with high reproducibility, maturity and viability. 3BTMs show morphological, functional and proteomic maturation of all cell types, leading to high similarity to their in vivo counterparts. Incorporated microglia survive for over 6 months and display mature morphology, functions and gene expression. Importantly, when engineered to model Alzheimer's disease pathology, 3BTMs recapitulate key disease hallmarks, including amyloid deposition, increased phospho-tau levels and neuroinflammation, with microglia shifting their transcriptional landscape to disease-relevant signatures. Treatment of Alzheimer's disease 3BTMs with anti-Aβ immunotherapy cleared deposits and largely reversed disease signatures in glia. Together, our microglia-containing model provides a platform for studying physiological and pathological states of human brain tissue.
authors: Klimmt J, Cardoso Gonçalves C, Montgomery JV, Müller SA, Bublitz M, Filser S, Paeger L, Nuscher B, Dannert A, Roeber S, Pravata V, Schifferer M, Shrouder JJ, Schulz N, González-Gallego J, Cappello S, Misgeld T, Plesnila N, Beltrán E, Herms J, De Domenico E, Beyer MD, Schultze JL, Haass C, Lichtenthaler SF, Carraro C, Paquet D.
screening_reason: Develops a 3D human brain tissue model to study microglial physiological and pathological phenotypes in neuroinflammation.
summary_ja: ヒトiPS細胞から誘導した神経細胞、アストロサイト、ミクログリアを含む再現性の高い3次元皮質脳組織モデルが開発されました。組み込まれたミクログリアは6ヶ月以上生存し、成熟した形態、機能、遺伝子発現パターンを維持しました。アルツハイマー病モデルではアミロイド沈着やリン酸化タウの増加とともに神経炎症が再現され、抗体療法により病理学的変化とグリアの異常な遺伝子変動が改善しました。このモデルはヒト脳の生理的機能や疾患における神経免疫応答を調べるプラットフォームとなります。
summary_en: Researchers developed a reproducible human iPSC-derived 3D cortical brain tissue model containing neurons, astrocytes, and functional microglia that survive for over six months. When engineered to model Alzheimer's disease pathology, the platform recapitulated amyloid deposition, phospho-tau elevation, and neuroinflammation. Furthermore, anti-amyloid immunotherapy cleared deposits and reversed disease-associated glial transcriptional signatures in this system.
key_finding_ja: 長期生存するミクログリアを含むヒト3次元脳組織モデルを確立し、アルツハイマー病様の神経炎症病態および薬物応答の再現に成功した。
why_it_matters_ja: ヒト特異的な神経免疫相互作用の解析や神経変性疾患の病態解明、創薬スクリーニングの精度向上に役立つことが期待されます。

title: Gut microbiota-derived trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO) and its association with neuroinflammation in migraine.
abstract: Background and objectives Migraine is a common primary headache disorder associated with neuroinflammation, with evidence implicating gut microbiota and metabolites in neurological mechanisms pathways. Since trimethylamine-N-oxide (TMAO), derived from dietary precursors by gut microbial metabolism, is associated with cardiovascular and neurodegenerative conditions, and its role in migraines is unclear, we aimed to evaluate whether serum TMAO level and related metabolites in migraine patients can be biomarkers. Methods A total of 106 participants were enrolled, consisting of healthy controls (n=46; mean age ± SD=39±8 yr old) and migraine patients (n=60). The migraine cohort was divided into migraine with aura (n=18; mean age±SD=33±11 yr old) and migraine without aura (n=42; mean age±SD=37±10 yr old), according to the International Classification of Headache Disorders, 3rd edition (ICHD-3). Blood samples were centrifuged, stored at -80°C, and analysed for TMAO, carnitine, betaine, and choline levels using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS). Results There were no significant differences between the groups for age, smoking, or body mass index (BMI). Serum TMAO levels were significantly higher in patients with migraine with aura [2.75 (1.98-3.91) ng/mL] and migraine without aura [2.85 (2.08-5.53) ng/mL] compared to controls [1.40 (1.00-3.01) ng/mL] (P<0.001). Serum choline, betaine, and carnitine levels were significantly higher in the migraine groups (all P < 0.01). Interpretation and conclusions These findings indicate elevated TMAO levels in patients with migraine, suggesting a possible involvement of TMAO in migraine-associated neuroinflammatory processes. Targeted studies and cohort-based investigations are needed to clarify its role in migraine and evaluate its potential as a biomarker.
authors: Atıcı Y, Eruyar E, Ökten Z, Serdar CC, Serdar MA, Yücel D.
journal: The Indian journal of medical research
screening_reason: Investigates gut microbiota-derived trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO) and its association with neuroinflammatory processes in migraine.
summary_ja: 本臨床研究では、偏頭痛患者60名（有前兆18名、無前兆42名）と健常対照者46名を対象に、腸内細菌由来代謝物であるトリメチルアミン-N-オキシド（TMAO）および関連代謝物の血清濃度を測定した。解析の結果、偏頭痛患者群では有前兆・無前兆にかかわらず、対照群と比較して血清TMAO、コリン、ベタイン、カルニチン濃度が有意に高値であった。これらの結果は、TMAOが偏頭痛に伴う神経炎症プロセスに関与している可能性を示唆している。著者らは、バイオマーカーとしての有用性や詳細な役割の解明に向けたさらなる検証が必要であると結論付けている。
summary_en: This clinical study evaluated serum levels of gut microbiota-derived trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO) and related metabolites in 60 migraine patients and 46 healthy controls. Serum TMAO, choline, betaine, and carnitine levels were significantly elevated in migraine patients both with and without aura compared to controls. These findings suggest that TMAO may be involved in migraine-associated neuroinflammatory processes and could serve as a potential biomarker.
key_finding_ja: 偏頭痛患者の血清中において、腸内細菌由来代謝物TMAOおよびその関連前駆体の濃度が健常対照者と比較して有意に高値であった。
why_it_matters_ja: 偏頭痛におけるTMAOの関与が確認されれば、診断バイオマーカーとしての活用や腸内細菌代謝を標的とした新たな治療法開発につながる可能性がある。
